question: Which state government launched the crop insurance portal 'Mukhya Mantri Bagwani Bima Yojana' in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mukhya Mantri Bagwani Bima Yojana:-**

 
 
• **The state government of Haryana launched the crop insurance portal 'Mukhya Mantri Bagwani Bima Yojana' in 2022.**
 
• This scheme aims to provide insurance coverage to farmers against any losses incurred due to natural calamities or other unforeseen events.
 
• The portal will also enable farmers to register themselves and apply for insurance policies online, making the process more accessible and hassle-free.
 
• The scheme will benefit around 22 lakh farmers in the state who will be able to avail of insurance coverage for various crops such as wheat, paddy, and vegetables.
 
• The Haryana government has allocated Rs. 1,000 crore for the implementation of this scheme. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has launched various schemes for farmers such as:-

 
 
• 'Kisan Kalyan Mission'
 
• 'Kisan Rin Mochan Yojana'
 
 
 
• **Punjab** has launched:-
 
 
• 'Kisan Vikas Schemes' to provide financial assistance to farmers for the purchase of seeds, fertilizers, and other agricultural inputs.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan:-**
 
 
• It​** **has launched the 'Kisan Mitra Yojana' to provide financial assistance to farmers for the purchase of agricultural equipment and machinery. 
 
• The state government has also launched the 'Mukhya Mantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana' to provide solar-powered water pumps to farmers.
